notes:
What's new in v1.11.1

New
- Hide while macros run: an option in the HUD overlay settings that makes the overlay step aside while any macro is running

Fixes
- Macro timing is much more consistent: delays no longer run long, and the small hitches between steps are gone, even with Reflex minimised or behind a game
- The HUD overlay is much lighter: it only redraws when something changes, so it no longer slows down your game or macros
- Overlay widgets no longer have a green strip down the left side
- Fixes and polish
